paragraphs.question: What earthshaking events will soon occur?
paragraphs.comment: We are living in the last of the last days. Jehovah will put into the hearts of the nations “his thought” so that they give their kingdom to the wild beast (the United Nations). That empowered beast will then remove false religion, marking the start of the great tribulation. Afterward the nations will attack Jehovah’s people, leading to Armageddon where Jesus and the 144,000 will deliver us into a righteous new world.

paragraphs.question: What will we consider in this article?
paragraphs.comment: We will examine Psalm 91 and answer three questions: What kind of protection does this psalm promise? How does Jehovah protect us now? How will he protect us in the future?

paragraphs.question: How do the opening words of Psalm 91 assure us of Jehovah’s protection? (Psalm 91:1, 2)
paragraphs.comment: The opening verses assure us that Jehovah protects those who trust in him. We are under the protective shadow and wings of the Most High. The words “refuge” and “stronghold” remind us of a walled city — safety inside the walls.

paragraphs.question: Psalm 91 ends with what promise, and what confidence does this give us? (Psalm 91:14-16)
paragraphs.comment: Jehovah himself speaks and repeatedly says “I will.” His protection is not a possibility — it is an absolute certainty because he is the Fulfiller of promises. We can therefore say with confidence: “You are my refuge and my stronghold.”

paragraphs.question: What kind of protection does Psalm 91 promise?
paragraphs.comment: Primarily spiritual security, but also physical and emotional protection for Jehovah’s people as a group. It is complete protection.

paragraphs.question: How did Jesus respond to one of Satan’s temptations, and what can we learn from his response? (Matthew 4:5-7)
paragraphs.comment: Satan quoted Psalm 91 to tempt Jesus to jump from the temple. Jesus did not deny that the psalm includes physical protection. He said we must not put Jehovah to the test. Satan misused the psalm by trying to force Jehovah’s hand. From this we correctly conclude that Psalm 91 promises complete protection while still requiring us not to act recklessly.

paragraphs.question: What confidence do we have?
paragraphs.comment: The inspired words of Psalm 91 fill us with confidence that Jehovah is the Protector of all who trust in him. We do not need to live in fear of the earthshaking events just ahead.

paragraphs.question: How is Jehovah protecting us spiritually?
paragraphs.comment: Jehovah gives us the help we need to combat spiritual dangers, especially our own sinful condition. He fully understands the powerful grip that sin has over us and provides practical help.

paragraphs.question: How can we win the fight against sinful desires? (Matthew 5:28, 29)
paragraphs.comment: Jesus shows that continuing to look at a person so as to have passion is already committing adultery in the heart. We must apply the “surgical cure” — cut passion-arousing material out of our lives as if it were a cancerous tumor.

paragraphs.question: How can holy spirit help protect us?
paragraphs.comment: If we keep praying for holy spirit, Jehovah will give it to us. The spirit does not remove wrong desires, but it strengthens our resolve to reject them immediately so that we do not carry them out.

paragraphs.question: How has Jehovah’s organization safeguarded us spiritually?
paragraphs.comment: Through timely publications and JW Broadcasting that address guilt, insecurity, and anxiety. Many of us have read something and thought, “That was written for me.” That is Jehovah reaching us through the organization.

paragraphs.question: What trials has Jehovah allowed some of his worshippers to face, and of what can we be sure?
paragraphs.comment: Jehovah has allowed some individuals to face persecution and even death to prove Satan a liar. But Satan will never succeed in wiping out pure worship as a whole. Jehovah uses his angels to protect the group so that pure worship continues uninterrupted.

paragraphs.question: What reason do we have not to expect that Jehovah will protect us from all physical harm at this time?
paragraphs.comment: If he protected every individual from all harm right now, Satan would claim we serve Jehovah only for the benefits. Because of the sanctification of his name, Jehovah has patiently tolerated injustice. That period is nearing its end.

paragraphs.question: How will Jehovah protect us in the future?
paragraphs.comment: He will continue spiritual protection through the great tribulation. When the nations attack, he will not allow his people to be exterminated as a group. That attack leads to Armageddon.

paragraphs.question: Why do we not need to fear the coming execution of divine judgment at Armageddon?
paragraphs.comment: Because we trust in Jehovah as our refuge and stronghold. Not one of God’s enemies will be left standing, and not one of his precious sheep will be killed. Once Armageddon begins, Jehovah will give complete physical, emotional, and spiritual protection — even as individuals.
